xscript.command.runOnDevice: Run Current Project on This Device
xscript.command.openTools: Open Developer Tools (图色 / 标注 / 投屏)
xscript.view.name: XScript
xscript.container.title: XScript
xscript.description: Upload, run and debug XScript / AScript projects on an Android device from VS Code or Cursor
xscript.config.title: XScript
xscript.config.device: Device address shown in the app (开发者地址). Use 127.0.0.1:<port> with `adb forward tcp:9860 tcp:9860`. Saved per workspace when one is open.
xscript.config.logPollMs: How often run logs are polled while following.
xscript.config.syncDeletes: Upload also deletes device files that were removed locally. Off by default; the files are listed and deleted only after you confirm. Files matched by .vscode/.syncignore, dot files and __pycache__ are never deleted. Device folders the deletes leave empty are removed too (listed in the same confirmation).
xscript.config.evalTimeoutMs: Timeout for Run Selection on Device.
xscript.config.adbPath: Path to adb for device scanning and the ADB terminal. Empty: use ANDROID_HOME / the usual SDK folders, then PATH.
xscript.config.scanLan: Also scan the local network (private /24 ranges) for devices, not only ADB.
